home.lead: Watch one video at the same moment with friends far away. Everyone's browser plays it by itself, so nothing is streamed through us and each of you chooses your own quality.
home.badCode: A room code has 6 letters and digits, like K7M2QX.
home.step1Text: One click gives you a short code. Send the code, or the invite link, to your friends.
home.step2Text: Paste a link or open a file from your disk. Everyone picks their own, or you share one with the whole room.
home.step3Text: Play, pause and seek are shared. The video itself never goes through our server.

room.shareCancelled: Sharing was cancelled or is not allowed here.
room.noAudio: No sound is being shared. Choose a browser tab and tick "Also share tab audio" in the picker, or add sound from a device below.
room.joinFailed: Could not join this room. It may be full.
room.noAudioFirefox: Firefox cannot share sound from a tab or window (on Linux with Wayland it never can). Add sound from a device below (on Linux the input named "Monitor of …"), use Chrome or Edge, or share the video file instead.
room.takenOver: Someone else started sharing, so your share was stopped. Now watching theirs.
room.noFrames: No picture is leaving this device even after switching the sharing method. This phone or browser cannot share video files. Share from a computer, or send the file.
room.switchedCapture: No picture was going out, so the sharing method was switched automatically.
room.differentCuts: Your copies of the video differ in length ({{lo}} to {{hi}}), so they are probably different cuts. Everyone should open the same file or link, or picture and sound will not line up.
room.resolvedHeaders: Found it, but this site expects special headers a browser cannot send, so it will probably not play. If it fails, share the tab or the file instead.
room.usedFallback: That quality did not load, so a lower one is used instead.

source.title: Your video
source.linkHint: YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, Streamable, or a direct video link (.mp4, .webm, .m3u8). Each person loads it themselves.
source.offerCheck: Offer this link to everyone in the room
source.offered: Your link is offered to the room.
source.openFile: Open a file from this device
source.shareFile: Share this file with the room
source.shareFileHint: Friends watch it straight from your browser (peer to peer), so they need no copy. Your upload speed sets their quality. Press play in your own player first.
source.fileHint: The file stays on your device. Open it, then share it with the room, or have everyone open the same file.
source.tabHint: For sites that only play on their own page: open the video in another tab and share that tab with sound.
source.tabFirefox: Heads up: Firefox cannot share sound. Use Chrome or Edge for a tab with sound, or share the file.
source.resolveHint: Asks this server (it runs yt-dlp) to find the video behind a page. It only works for some sites, and the result may refuse to play for you or your friends: many hosts tie the link to the server's address or to their own site.

player.emptyText: Pick a link, a file or a tab below. Everyone in the room picks their own, or you can share one with everybody.
player.sharingTitle: You are sharing a tab or window
player.sharingCount_one: {{count}} person is watching. Play and pause in the shared tab itself.
player.sharingCount_other: {{count}} people are watching. Play and pause in the shared tab itself.
player.joinHint: Your browser needs one tap before it lets the video start.
player.failed: Could not connect directly to the sharer. Strict networks or VPNs can block this. Ask them to send the file instead, or try again.
player.notSynced: Live streams and clips cannot be synchronized: everyone watches on their own.

errors.offline: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.no_room: This room does not exist (or it expired after being empty for a while).
errors.busy: The server is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.slow_down: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
errors.badLink: This does not look like a link. Paste the full address, starting with https://
errors.mixed: This page is secure (https), so the browser blocks plain http links. Use an https link or open the file from disk.
errors.noHls: This browser cannot play HLS (.m3u8) streams.
errors.hlsNetwork: Could not load the stream. The link may have expired, or the host does not allow other websites to read it (CORS). Try a fresh link or the file on your disk.
errors.hlsFatal: The stream could not be played.
errors.mediaNetwork: The network failed while loading the video. The link may have expired.
errors.mediaDecode: Your browser could not decode this video.
errors.mediaUnsupported: Your browser cannot play this link: it may be expired, blocked for other sites, or not a video the browser supports (try the file instead).
errors.mediaGeneric: The video could not be loaded.
errors.ytLoad: YouTube could not be loaded (blocked or offline).
errors.ytPlay: YouTube would not play this video (private, removed or embedding disabled).
errors.vimeoPlay: Vimeo would not play this video (private, removed or embedding disabled).
errors.noCapture: This browser cannot share a playing file. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer.
errors.noPicture: The video has no picture to share yet. Press play once and try again.
errors.noPictureViewer: Connected, but no picture is arriving. The sharer's device may not be able to share this file (phones often cannot). Ask them to share from a computer, or send the file.
errors.embedBlocked: This video did not load. It may be private, removed, or not allowed to be embedded on other sites.
errors.twitchLoad: Twitch could not be loaded (blocked or offline).
errors.bad_url: That does not look like a usable page address.
errors.blocked_host: This server does not look up that address.
errors.unsupported: No extractor knows this site, so the video could not be found.
errors.login: This video needs a login or is private, so it cannot be looked up.
errors.no_single_stream: The site only offers separate picture and sound streams, which a browser cannot play from one address.
errors.unavailable: The video is unavailable or was removed.
errors.refused: The site refused this server's request.
errors.failed: The lookup failed. Try again later or share the tab or the file.
errors.unavailable_tool: The lookup tool is not installed on this server.
errors.audioFailed: The sound could not be loaded.

sound.title: Add sound from a device
sound.hint: Shares more than the tab. On Linux pick the input named "Monitor of …" to send everything you hear. On Windows Chrome you can instead choose "Entire screen" and tick "Share system audio".
sound.denied: Sound inputs could not be listed. Allow microphone access for this site (it is only used to reach the device you pick).
sound.failed: That input could not be opened.

pwa.iosHint: Tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
